# Krishna Enterprise

Krishna Enterprise is a stationery distribution business based in Rajkot, Saurashtra,
Gujarat. We connect trusted stationery brands with retailers, resellers, schools,
institutions and commercial buyers across the region, offering writing instruments,
notebooks and paper, office essentials, files and folders, school stationery, art and
craft, and desk accessories.
